title: KODAI SOBAKIRI IS THE 2026 D1GP CHAMPION

headline: KODAI SOBAKIRI
IS THE 2026
D1GP CHAMPION
data.body: He failed to qualify on Saturday while Naoki Nakamura won Round 9. On Sunday a Top 4 finish was enough to clinch his first D1 Grand Prix title.

caption:
Kodai Sobakiri is the 2026 D1 Grand Prix champion. 🇯🇵 A tense final weekend at TOKYO DRIFT in Odaiba: no qualifying on Saturday, then a Top 4 finish on Sunday to seal his first series title. He said he was nervous the whole time.
